folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B282: cultivation bindings and evidence ownership
folds.body:
The full [engine-bindings checkpoint](gm/dispatch/engine-bindings-2026-10-22/CHECKPOINT.md) supplies seven concrete first bindings, not every missing cultivation engine behavior: E1 practiced sluice reserve cost at fixed output; E2 helper person reservation with shared quote; E3 explicit process treatment read by two material output-quality paths; E4 active earning-body faculty with retained knowledge; E5a one-time history binding an actual wage/duty; E5b institutional funds/policy succession apart from personal wages/energy; and E6 guided versus probed environmental access. E3 treatment is explicitly not inherited automatically. E4's different-body case was test-only because no ordinary native body swap was present. Exact costs, output rates and source defaults describe those selected mechanisms rather than a universal recipe.

The record's final proof reports build, 2,528 tests, architecture/rules checks and one rebuilt 1920×1080 E1/E5a mill-race journey with current-format persistence. It explicitly leaves keeper-built payout, E2 gathering, E3 hides, E4 hazard, E5b pantry and E6 fen browser proof open at that closeout, along with laptop/21px cases. Do not turn the full-suite result into native coverage of those consumers. The later user instruction transfers that browser backlog to the [W1–W4 owner](gm/dispatch/distinct-world-w1-w4-2026-10-22/CHECKPOINT.md); it does not assign today's task to redo the old work. W3/W4 minimal bindings and W1/W2 modules are first slices, distinct from the broader worker/student, earned-office and intake-law journeys. Later W evidence must retain its own input/date.

O4 records that closed-browser policy was not implemented in this task. That dated unresolved-policy sentence does not erase current world-clock direction or authorize a new offline mode. Optional child state is absent by default, migration invents no prior history, and malformed state must reject through its real owner. Runtime reservations were released; early source-only table labels, paused coordination and obsolete direct test commands are historical. This join changes documentation only and adds no gameplay gate, new Frontier/Mistglass depth or renewed source/test proof.
